message: Endpoint description for GET /reports contains "---" which will be interpreted as a YAML frontmatter delimiter by the docs renderer, causing parsing failures and 500 errors on the generated docs site. Remove the "---" delimiters from the description.

Tag name "Rapports 📊" contains non-ASCII characters: 📊. Non-ASCII characters in tag names will be included in URL paths and HTTP headers, which only support ASCII characters. This will cause runtime errors (ERR_INVALID_CHAR). Remove non-ASCII characters from the tag name.
